## History

Nettie Scobie was regarded as a very capable manager and saver, and was liked fairly well by [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md). Following Nell's rejection of Barney's marriage proposal, Barney's sister [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) noted that he would likely marry Nettie instead.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_
